attributes.name: Mister Plugg
attributes.powers:
Before you act, succeed at a Wisdom or Survival 8 check or Mister Plugg is evaded.

After you act, bury a card.

"Stealing from the ship's stores, are we? I'll have discipline on this ship if I have to toss every last one of ye overboard! Perhaps a keelhaulin' will be more to your liking. We'll throw whatever's left of ye to the sharks!"—Mister Plugg, at the "Bloody Hour"
